$comment: Cross-client CONSOLE-UI parity vectors. The palette table (cell_ramp, mesh_interior, palettes) is consumed by pf-console-ui's Rust tests, the Android app's ConsoleVectorsTest and the Apple client's ConsoleVectorsTests; the version 3 blocks by the Rust tests alone, since the Skia console draws them on every platform. Sibling of deeplink-vectors.json, same rules: this file is the contract, and a value absent here is a value no client may assume.
$shell_tabs: Version 3: the console's top-level tabs, in strip order. The Skia shell draws them on every platform, so its Rust twin pins them; Apple and Android hold no copy.
$settings_sections: Version 3: the Settings tab's sections, in tab order. The Skia shell draws them on every platform, so its Rust twin pins them.
$backdrop_pairs: Version 4: each palette's two dominant colours, the pools of the Skia console's field. Only its Rust twin draws the field, so only it pins this; the 16-cell meshes above are the native palette pickers' and the Android licences screen's backdrop.
$motion_springs: Version 3: the redesign's motion table (design section 3). Springs are integrator-dependent, so this pins parameters, not sampled positions. nav carries the push/pop geometry too: Back mid-push retargets the same spring (interruptible). The Skia shell animates every screen, so its Rust twin pins it.
